## Futures Earn

## 💰 Futures Earn — Up to 8% APY
Put your eligible Futures balance to work!
Register for Futures Earn and transfer eligible funds to your Futures account to earn 2% base APY.

Yield Type | APY
Base APY | 2%
Additional APY (10×–100× Leverage) | Up to 6%
Total APY | Up to 8%
Additional APY depends on the applicable leverage tier. Eligible balances and reward limits are subject to the Futures Earn rules.
## 📌 Terms & Conditions
Separate Registration: Futures League and Futures Earn are two independent campaigns. Users must register for each campaign separately to participate and receive the corresponding rewards.
Futures Earn Eligibility: To earn the 2% base APY, users must successfully register for Futures Earn and transfer eligible funds to their Futures Account. Registration alone does not generate interest. Only eligible funds held in the Futures Account after registration qualify for the base APY.
Additional APY: Users can unlock up to 6% additional APY by opening qualifying Futures positions with eligible leverage (10×–100×), bringing the total APY to up to 8%. The actual additional APY depends on the applicable leverage tier.
Interest Calculation: Interest is calculated based on eligible funds and qualifying positions in accordance with the Futures Earn rules. Transferring funds out of the Futures Account or failing to meet the eligibility requirements may affect interest earnings.
Futures League Rewards: Users can earn rewards by completing campaign tasks and reaching cumulative Futures trading volume milestones. Milestone rewards are cumulative, and only successfully executed trades count toward trading volume.
Reward Distribution: Futures Coupons will be distributed according to the campaign’s reward distribution schedule and are subject to their respective usage rules.
Fair Participation: Wash trading, self-trading, multiple-account abuse, and other fraudulent activities are prohibited. Biconomy.com reserves the right to disqualify users involved in such activities and revoke related rewards.

## Terms & Conditions
- Trade LISTAUSDT Perpetual Futures during the campaign. Cumulative trading volume includes both opening and closing orders, as well as Long and Short positions.

Exchange/platform: Pump.fun
Headline: Pump.fun app referral: your friend's first purchase matched up to $50 — for both of you
Start: 2026-10-16T00:00:00Z · End: 2026-11-30T23:59:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 50 USD
Note: the rules text below may be incomplete (only the announcement preview was available).
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Invite a friend to the Pump.fun app with your referral link or code.
The friend makes a first fiat purchase (deposit) in the app — the reward equals that first purchase, up to $50, for the friend and for you.
The reward is paid in installments only if the friend trades on 5 separate days within 10 days after the deposit is confirmed: 1/6 on each of the first four trading days and 2/6 on the fifth.
If the friend does not reach 5 trading days within the 10-day window, the remaining installments are forfeited.
Referred users also get about 10% lower trading fees. Referrers earn a share of their friends' fees (the temporary 4x referrer boost ended on November 2, 2026; referrers now get 1.5x — 37.5% of referred users' fees).
Installments are credited after review. Pump.fun has not announced an end date — check the in-app Rewards section before inviting.

Exchange/platform: Bybit
Headline: Bybit referral: up to 250 USDT for you and up to 250 USDT for your friend
Start: 2026-10-30T00:00:00Z · End: not stated
Most one person can get (parsed): 250 USDT
Smallest threshold (parsed): 50 USD (trade)
Note: the rules text below may be incomplete (only the announcement preview was available).
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Invite a friend with your referral link. Both of you get the same reward at each step:
Step 1: the friend makes a first trade of at least $50 within 14 days of registration — 50 USDT each.
Step 2: the friend reaches at least $500 cumulative trading volume within 30 days after the first trade — 100 USDT each.
Step 3: the friend reaches at least $10,000 trading volume within the same 30 days — another 100 USDT each.
Trading volume counts spot, derivatives, options, Alpha, convert and other products on all sub-accounts; zero-fee trading pairs do not count.
Payout: every reward first goes through a 3-day risk review, then appears in the Rewards Hub. It must be claimed within 10 days, otherwise it expires.
The monthly pool is 500,000 USDT with a daily claim limit (first come, first served; friends with higher trading volume go first). If today's limit is used up, claim the next day — the daily pool refills at 00:00 UTC, while the monthly pool lasts.
The FAQ does not say whether these rewards are withdrawable USDT or vouchers: it lists Fee Savers (non-withdrawable, only reduce trading fees) and Position Airdrops (trading vouchers) among its reward types. Check the reward's details page in the Rewards Hub before relying on cash.
Referrers also earn 20% of the friend's net trading fees (25–30% at higher levels), paid daily at 04:00 UTC, for 365 days after the friend registers.
Only for Bybit Global users — not available on Bybit EU / in the EEA and other restricted regions.
